Description: Finding products: PLP faceted navigation, search, sort, pagination, related rails. From discovery call.
Cart, persistence, guest checkout, express checkout, checkout step flow, order placement, payment states.
Promotions engine, reviews/UGC, cross-sell/upsell, cart-abandonment, wishlist, back-in-stock, analytics.
Catalog CMS, product/variant modelling, category tree, RBAC, OMS view, pricing display, content pages, reporting.
Registration, login/session, password reset, profile, address book, verification, consent capture.
Customer order history, order tracking, invoice download, self-service returns/cancellation, reorder.
Cookie consent, policy pages, T&C acceptance, data-subject requests, grievance officer, cross-cutting compliance.

As a shopper I want to combine multiple filters at once on the product listing page (PLP) - category, brand, price range, rating, attributes - so I can narrow results quickly. Faceted navigation, the way large marketplaces let you stack several facets simultaneously and refine live. Show result counts per facet value e.g. 'Brand A (24)'. Must be usable on mobile.

As a shopper I want autocomplete suggestions as I type and tolerance for synonyms/misspellings so I still find items when my wording differs from the catalog term (e.g. 'sneakers' should match items tagged 'trainers'). Typeahead/predictive search as seen on major storefronts.
As a shopper who searches something we don't have, I want 'did you mean' suggestions and fallback recommendations instead of a dead-end blank page, so I don't bounce.
Sort by relevance (default), price low-high / high-low, newest, popularity. Standard PLP sorting.
As a shopper I want to add 2-3 products to a compare view and see attributes side by side. Common on higher-consideration categories. NOTE: Karan flagged as maybe-not-v1. DECISION PENDING.

As a shopper on a PDP I want 'you may also like' / 'people also viewed' rails, so I discover more. Cross-sell/upsell rails comparable to the 'customers also bought' modules on large storefronts. Recommendation logic can start rule-based.
Breadcrumbs on PLP/PDP reflecting the category tree so users can navigate up levels and don't get lost.
As a shopper browsing a large category I want the PLP to page or lazy-load results rather than dumping everything, so it stays fast. Ties to perf NFR-PERF-03.

As a shopper I want a PDP with image gallery/zoom, description, price, and a variant selector (e.g. size/colour) where each variant is its own SKU with its own stock. Add-to-cart resolves to a specific SKU.
Add, change qty, remove. Cart persists across sessions/devices for logged-in users. Show line totals, subtotal, estimated total.

As a returning user who added items as a guest and then logs in, I want my guest (session) cart merged into my account cart rather than lost - the way major platforms reconcile a session cart into the account cart on sign-in.

As a shopper I want to check out without creating an account (email + address + pay), so I'm not forced to register. Offer optional account creation post-purchase with email pre-filled. NOTE: BRD lists this as OPEN; Growth pushing for IN. Needs Meera's sign-off.
As a returning logged-in user with a saved address + tokenised saved card I want a shortened express-checkout path, to reduce friction. Per CommerceForge email - tokenised, we store no card data.

As a shopper I want a clear checkout sequence: (1) delivery address, (2) shipping method, (3) order review with totals + taxes, (4) payment, (5) confirmation. Keep steps minimal. Show applicable charges before payment.
As a shopper I want to enter a promo code at checkout and see the discount reflected in totals before paying. Consumes the promotions engine (HRZN-30).

Summary: Pincode serviceability + address validation at checkout
Description: As a shopper I want to check whether my PIN code is serviceable (and see a delivery ETA) on the PDP and at checkout, and be blocked with a clear message if it isn't. COD availability may also vary by pincode. Per Ops intake C4.

On successful payment (or COD acceptance) the customer sees an on-screen confirmation with order number and summary, and receives a confirmation email. Ties to notifications (Ops D1) and GST invoice (payments thread).

As a shopper whose payment fails, times out or is pending, I want clear feedback and the ability to retry without losing my cart, and the order must not be marked confirmed until the PSP confirms success. Handle gateway callback/webhook reliably.
Support promo codes with cart-level and item-level discounts (percent or flat), min-order thresholds, expiry, usage limits. Ananya needs a launch code live. NOT resolved in BRD.
As a shopper I want star ratings + written reviews on the PDP with an average rating. Needs a moderation queue for user-generated content (UGC). Growth wants launch; not confirmed in scope. DISPUTED.

As Growth I want an automated reminder email to users who leave items in cart after N hours, to recover abandoned carts. NOTE: per Legal, this is MARKETING - only to opted-in customers (see HRZN-77). Not in BRD.
As a shopper I want to save products to a wishlist to buy later. Flagged in discovery as a 'maybe'; likely lives in the account area.
As a shopper viewing an out-of-stock item I want to sign up to be emailed when it's back. Per Ops intake A3. Transactional-ish but confirm consent treatment.

As Growth I want the funnel instrumented (view -> PDP -> add-to-cart -> checkout -> purchase) so we can see and fix drop-off. Satisfies the BRD 'visibility' objective. MUST respect cookie/marketing consent (HRZN-75). Ties to NFR-OBS-02.

Summary: Catalog CMS - manage products without eng
Description: As a merchandiser I want to create/edit/publish/unpublish products, prices and images myself, so I don't raise an eng ticket for catalog changes. Core reason for the rebuild per BRD.
As an admin I want to define and reorganise the category tree (used by nav + breadcrumbs + facets) without code.
As an admin I want role-based access control so ops, CX, merchandising and finance each see only what they should. Enforced per NFR-SEC-07; actions audit-logged per NFR-SEC-08.
Staff can view orders, update order state, trigger refunds/credit notes, and see payment + fulfilment status in one place (lightweight OMS view).

As a shopper I want to see selling price with MRP strikethrough and discount %, with prices shown tax-inclusive (invoice still shows the tax split per Finance). Admin sets MRP + selling price per SKU.

Summary: Content pages CMS (home banners + policy pages)
Description: As a team I want to manage homepage banners and static/policy pages (T&C, Privacy, Return, Shipping, Cookie) as editable content, not hard-coded, so we can update copy without a developer. Hosts the Legal policy pages (HRZN-71).
As the business I want a basic dashboard of sales, orders and stock (no manual spreadsheet exports), so we finally have visibility. Directly satisfies the BRD 'visibility' objective.
As a new customer I want to create an account with email + password, so I can save details and see my orders. Password rules enforced; stored hashed per NFR-SEC-02.
As a returning customer I want to log in and log out securely, with a 'remember me' option. Session handling per NFR-SEC-03; rate-limited per NFR-SEC-05.
As a customer who forgot my password I want a secure reset via email link / OTP, so I can regain access. Rate-limited; link/OTP expires.
As a customer I want to view and edit my profile (name, contact, communication preferences).
As a customer I want to save multiple delivery addresses and pick a default, so checkout is faster. Feeds express checkout (HRZN-24).
As the platform I want to verify a customer's email and/or mobile via OTP at signup, to reduce fake accounts and enable order comms. Rate-limited per NFR-SEC-05.
As a customer I want to log in via Google or mobile OTP instead of a password. NICE-TO-HAVE - likely phase 2, decision pending.

As the platform I must capture marketing consent SEPARATELY and OPT-IN (not bundled with signup or T&C) per Legal, and store the consent state, so promo/marketing sends only go to opted-in users. Provide easy withdraw/unsubscribe.
As a customer I want to see a list of my past and current orders with status, so I can keep track. Guest orders lookup via order-number + email (since guest checkout has no account).
As a customer I want an order detail page showing items, amounts, a status timeline (Confirmed -> Shipped -> Delivered) and the carrier tracking link/AWB. Tracking data per Ops intake C1.

Summary: Download GST invoice from order page
Description: As a customer I want to download the GST tax-invoice PDF for my order (and a credit note for refunds). Invoice content/compliance per payments thread (Finance).

Summary: Raise a return (RMA) from order page
Description: As a customer I want to request a return for eligible items from my order page within the return window, kicking off the RMA flow (CX approval -> reverse pickup -> inspect -> refund/credit note). Full flow per Ops/CX intake E. Window (7 vs 10 days) UNDECIDED.
As a customer I want to cancel an order before it ships, triggering stock release and a refund if prepaid. Per Ops intake B2.
As a returning customer I want to reorder a past order in one tap. NICE-TO-HAVE, phase 2.

As required by Legal, show a cookie-consent banner on first visit allowing accept/reject of non-essential (analytics/marketing) cookies; store the choice; don't fire non-essential trackers before consent. Gates analytics (HRZN-35).

T&C, Privacy Policy, Return/Refund/Cancellation Policy, Shipping Policy, Cookie Policy - all live at launch, linked in the footer sitewide and at checkout. Managed as content via CMS (HRZN-45). Per Legal.

Summary: T&C + return policy acceptance at checkout
Description: Before placing an order the customer must tick (not pre-ticked) acceptance of the Terms and Return Policy, with links. Record acceptance + terms version + timestamp against the order. Per Legal point 2.

Provide a documented way for a customer to request access to, correction of, or erasure of their personal data (admin-assisted acceptable for launch). Erasure must NOT delete statutory tax records (Finance) - erase profile/marketing data, retain invoices. Per Legal point 5 + Priyanka.
Publish name/role + contact email of a Grievance Officer on the site as required (DPDP). CX (Neha) owns the inbox. Per Legal point 6.

Summary: Facet counts wrong after applying a filter
Description: Repro: apply brand facet, price facet counts don't recalculate against the filtered set - still show global counts. Expected: counts reflect current facet selection.

Summary: Stock not released on abandoned unpaid order
Description: If checkout is started (stock reserved) but payment never completes, reserved stock isn't released after timeout - risks phantom out-of-stock. Needs a reservation timeout. Ties to NFR-SCL-02.
